description: For the person's own booking or service request: reports a problem to the owner in the person's words, the same as the "Something wrong?" box on their page. The owner replies to the person directly. It does not cancel, refund or change anything. Read it back to the person, then pass confirm: true. Needs their private link.

code.description: Instead of link: the token= or t= value from that link

confirm.description: true once the person has approved the report

link.description: The person's private link: the manage link from a booking email (…/manage.html?ref=…&token=…) or the status link from a request email (…/requests/SR-…?t=…)

ref.description: Instead of link: the reference, e.g. SR-AB12CD

what_happened.description: What went wrong, in the person's own words

name: report_problem
title: Tell MCC something went wrong
